title: Negative results and claim revision
outcome: Explain negative results and claim revision using the records and boundaries of this fictional investigation.
scenario: A negative result changes the claim. A proposed prompt improvement ties the baseline on a fixed eight-case evaluation.
given: A and B each score 6/8. Before running, the team predicted B would score higher.

steps.label: Recall the prediction
steps.detail: The claim was a higher correct count for B.

steps.label: State the finding
steps.detail: Both versions score 75%; no observed count advantage appears here.

steps.label: Revise cautiously
steps.detail: Report the unsupported prediction and a justified next test.

explanation: A negative result can be informative when methods and limits are clear. A tie does not prove the methods are equivalent under all conditions or that the experiment was worthless.

counterfactual.change: B wins on one new task after the team chooses it because A fails.
counterfactual.prediction: Treat that selected demonstration as exploratory, not a replacement for the original result.
counterfactual.reason: Case selection now depends on outcomes.

student_task: Does a 6/8 tie support the prediction that B scores higher? Explain why one newly selected favourable demonstration does not replace the original result or prove equivalence.
teacher_answer: The claim was a higher correct count for B. Both versions score 75%; no observed count advantage appears here. Report the unsupported prediction and a justified next test. Changed case: Treat that selected demonstration as exploratory, not a replacement for the original result. Case selection now depends on outcomes. A tie on eight cases does not prove equivalence.
project_evidence: For the Reproducible AI Research Study, retain an annotated worked trace and the changed-case reasoning. Connect the claim to its records, units and assumptions so another investigator can challenge or reproduce it.
limits: A tie on eight cases is not an equivalence test; uncertainty and practical thresholds remain unspecified.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice distinct from the reserved independent case. No invented significance, real experiment execution or pupil outcome is asserted.

mini_visual.title: No observed count advantage
mini_visual.unit: correct cases out of 8 shared cases
